before: A data-bound content control refused every paragraph property write and every decision on a paragraph property change inside it.
after: A data binding lets paragraph property writes (properties, tab stops, list numbering, list level) and decisions on paragraph property changes through. A content lock on the same control applies its own rule. Text edits in bound content stay refused.
reason: Only local admission widens. The ops, the shared fields, and their encoding are unchanged, and the writes travel through the existing paragraph property path.
